task.description: Ingesting the live outbox after the dogfood gave accepted 6 and rejected 8, every rejection reading AST syntax validation failed: Trace must contain at least one filled hole or a rejected attempt. storypole builds filled_holes from task scope target_symbols, so a task verified with no symbols writes a structurally invalid record while a task with symbols passes - the writer and the gate disagree about what a valid trace is, and 8 of 14 records were lost on the first real run. Either storypole should emit a scope signature or a rejected attempt marker for symbol-less tasks, or the gate should accept a receipt-only Silver trace.
task.title: storypole verify traces without target symbols are rejected by the rabbet gate

receipt.summary: gate rule now accepts a verified scope as evidence; rabbet-core tests (2 new), clippy and fmt green; live re-ingest of the same 18 records went from accepted 8 / duplicates 7 / rejected 10 to accepted 18 / 0 / 0; patterns still 0 because they require Gold
